title.narrative: Promote cultural diversity and creative economies

description.narrative: This workplan supports the implementation of the 2005 Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions and UNESCO’s 43 C/5 Programme by strengthening cultural policies, governance frameworks, and creative ecosystems in Chile and other countries covered by the UNESCO Santiago Office. It promotes evidence-based cultural policymaking, improved cultural data and reporting systems, and the dissemination of Quadrennial Periodic Reports. The initiative supports artists, cultural professionals, and creative industries through actions that foster decent work, cultural entrepreneurship, market access, and the circulation of cultural expressions. It also leverages UNESCO Creative Cities and cultural networks to advance innovation, sustainable urban development, cultural diversity, and inclusive economic growth.
